description: Two-stage track moisture: stage1 = carry-over + weather + race drift - seasonal OOS bias; stage2 = shift 2R+ by 1R official error (M7).

feature_definitions.prev_last: official moisture of the previous meeting day's last race
feature_definitions.Pb: precipitation_sum summed over calendar days strictly between previous meeting day and race day
feature_definitions.Eb: et0 summed over days strictly between meetings

rounding: clamp 0.5..8 then half-up to 0.1 (same as v1)

season_correction.method: stage1 = regression - value[group]; value = mean out-of-sample residual (pred-actual) of expanding-window refits in the 365 days before cutoff; groups with <30 races -> 0

stage2.anchor: race 1 official moisture (NAR RaceList 馬場 column)
stage2.deadline: anchor must be retrieved strictly before race 2 scheduled start; otherwise stage1 stays effective (fallback)
stage2.per_race_deadline: stage2 saved strictly before each race start

fallbacks: no 1R anchor before 2R start -> stage1 (carry-over based)
no previous-meeting official moisture or missing weather between meetings -> v1 frozen formula (flag stage1_v1_fallback)
